question: If an Oklahoma CDL applicant passes the pre-trip inspection but fails the basic control skills section of the drive test, what happens?
choice_a: They keep credit for the passed pre-trip inspection and only need to retest the failed basic control skills section
choice_b: They must retake all three components from the beginning

explanation: If an Oklahoma applicant passes one section of the drive/skills test but fails another, they keep credit for the passed section and only have to retest the failed one.
